rules.description: The lease's current state is admitted by a canonical Agentgres operation carried by reference; the family owns no lease-transition chain of its own.
Delivery scope is content-bound: a lease names the exact projection hash and at least one permitted class, so a substituted projection cannot be presented as the leased one.
Every lease declares a backpressure policy reference, so lag resolves to a typed outcome rather than a silent drop.
